items.description:
Contributions are welcome. Read the contribution guidelines before opening a pull request. One focused resource per PR keeps review evidence clear.
For broken links, outdated descriptions, or missing categories, use the repository's structured issue forms. SUPPORT.md routes broader questions, and SECURITY.md covers private vulnerability reporting.
Maintenance is best-effort. Inclusion does not mean endorsement, security certification, or a promise that a third-party project will remain available.
